newsitem.title: UK: Gottesman office declines Olivetti comment.
newsitem.headline: Gottesman office declines Olivetti comment.

text.p: The legal firm of U.S. financier Edward Gottesman declined on Tuesday to comment on reports that he was interested in bidding for the ailing personal computer business of Italy's information technology company Olivetti.
"The policy from this office is "no comment'," said a spokeswoman for London-based legal firm Gottesman, Jones and Partners.

Gottesman, who also heads venture capital company Centenary Group, has linked up with Gianmario Rossignolo, the chairman of Electrolux unit Zanussi, in a bid for the PC division. Analysts speculate the business could be worth about 200 billion lire.
Olivetti is expected imminently to sell the business, which is seen as a huge liability.
U.S corporate debt trader Gary Klesch, who heads London-based Klesch and Co, has also been tipped by newspapers as a potential bidder. A company spokesman declined to comment.
